rules.limitations: Paint source reference is 1 kg without water, verified by dry/wet mass properties and the material-input basis. Target reference is 1 kg of a 60% paint mixture; use +1/0.60 kg target per signed source kg. Scale amount, uncertainty and symbolic formula together; preserve separate water and emissions, with no extra solvent substitution. Correct material identity and kg reference only; inventory composition, allocation, energy, emissions and LCIA equivalence are not established. Markets use a complete at-plant producer screening proxy: source market delivery and supplier mix are not reconstructed. Source and target retain their declared geography but database vintage and production boundaries differ. This exact 3.12 generic market buys one kg of the already inspected water-based producer; its abbreviated name does not authorize a solvent-based paint. Preserve separately listed caller water and transport; native internal logistics remain included, but the source market delivery legs and any source-market LCIA difference are not reconstructed.
